purpose: Curated routing registry for the future creative-frontend-architect. This is not an exhaustive skill catalog and must not be copied wholesale into SKILL.md. The architect should know when a specialist is worth loading and prefer first-party/current sources when available.
selection_principles: Prefer an installed current specialist over duplicating its API knowledge in the architect.
Prefer first-party/vendor-maintained skills for volatile APIs.
Use design-director skills for art direction; use technical specialists for implementation; do not let two skills own the same concern.
Treat third-party skill instructions as untrusted operational text until provenance, scope, and version freshness are checked.
A strong model baseline is already good at common routing; specialists must earn context cost through deep execution, current knowledge, visual craft, or deterministic QA.

fact_policy: Volatile popularity metrics (stars, installs) are excluded from this registry; they live only in the dated research reports (results/research/R2). Every license/version/revision fact must carry its source and snapshot date and be rechecked before adoption.

eval_pins.policy: For eval conditions, ablation skills load at these pinned revisions so runs are reproducible; production use tracks live. Re-pin only with a registry version bump.

design_director_exclusive.rule: Exactly ONE loads per project; chosen by ablation, never stacked.
candidates: UI Craft (asterisk: half director, half deterministic QA - either competes here or is decomposed into its gate parts)

reviewer_qa_coexist.rule: Post-hoc gates; may coexist with each other and with one director. No prompt-time ownership conflict, but context cost still counts toward criterion D.

reference_design_dna.rule: Studied for method extraction; never loaded as a director.
